rules: event_phases contains existing legal activity phases only. view_state_description is human guidance, never a new business enum. Expand each group into individually recorded legal captures, not a Cartesian product of all flags.

Formal play is only valid in PLAYING unless an actual permitted original-slot replacement grant applies; practice uses existing CHECK_IN/PLAYING rules. Gift creation is only in permitted REDEEMING; CLOSED may show already-existing claim orders under their actual deadline. Frozen is a separate business restriction, not a new phase.
Use an isolated development event or development-only component/scene visual fixture; never modify production records or stage gates for a screenshot.
Fixtures must not generate formal scores, slots, ledger writes, gift reservations or real claim codes. Do not fake human/device/onsite PASS to reach PLAYING.
fixture is not real API evidence. Use actual permitted service scenarios separately for business interaction checks.
Record CSS viewport, DPR, browser zoom, case ID, app build, asset version, font-loaded status, decode status and screenshot scope.
Capture both first viewport and full-page for lobby. For games record deterministic replay/checkpoint or explicitly visual-only view fixture. A display fixture is not a legal replay test.
Freeze decorative animation only in fixtures; do not change production time or input logic. Separate motion review uses actual running animation.
No production credentials, personal identity, complete QR claim tokens or private data in screenshots. Staff/claim samples use isolated nonredeemable fixtures.
Compare the same business state; 941x1672 reference may be scaled uniformly for side-by-side, never stretched to 390x844.
